translations.web: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
translations.bsb: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.
translations.kjv: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
translations.asv: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the lofty people of the earth do languish.
